_readme: Hand-curated stances. This is the ONLY place the site is allowed to claim that a lobby
organisation was for or against a specific bill.
The Lobbyregister records WHICH Drucksache an organisation lobbied on, but never whether
it wanted the bill passed or stopped. That direction cannot be derived from the data, and
guessing it from the wording of a demand would turn a statistical observation into an
unsourced allegation about how an MP voted. So it is curated by hand, with a source, and
reviewed in git history like any other change.
Every entry needs a source URL that a reader can check — normally the organisation's own
position paper (the register links these under 'statements' / 'Stellungnahmen').
drucksache printed matter the stance refers to, e.g. '21/6130'
'contra' = wanted it stopped or substantially weakened
note       one line, in German, quoting or closely paraphrasing the stated position
source     URL of the position paper or statement the stance is taken from
Anything not listed here simply has no direction on the site: the organisation's own
headline demand is shown verbatim instead, and the reader draws their own conclusion.
